source.author: cic
source.text: at hoc in eo M. Crasso, quem semel ait in vita risisse Lucilius, non contigit, ut ea re minus , ut ait idem, vocaretur.
source.text_original: at hoc in eo M. Crasso, quem semel ait in vita risisse Lucilius, non contigit, ut ea re minus ἀγέλαστος, ut ait idem, vocaretur.
source.text_english: But this did not happen in the case of M. Crassus, whom Lucilius says laughed only once in his life, so that on that account he was not for that reason, as the same writer says, called any the less.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: accessit huic patellae iuxta tritum populi sermone prouerbium dignum operculum, Lupicinus sacerdos secundum illud quoque, de quo semel in uita Crassum ait risisse Lucilius:
reuse.text_original: accessit huic patellae iuxta tritum populi sermone prouerbium dignum operculum, Lupicinus sacerdos — secundum illud quoque, de quo semel in uita Crassum ait risisse Lucilius:
reuse.text_english: To this dish there was added, in accordance with the familiar proverb of the people, a worthy lid: the priest Lupicinus, too, in keeping with that saying about which Lucilius said that Crassus once laughed at it in his life.
